question: Point out the correct answer regarding carcinogenesis:

options.opb: Mutation of tumor suppressor genes causes an activation of their normal function.
options.opc: The RB gene is an oncogene.
options.opd: The RAS gene is a tumor suppressor gene.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Mutation of tumor suppressor genes can lead to loss of their normal function -> Loss of tumor suppressor gene function can result in uncontrolled cell growth -> Uncontrolled cell growth is a hallmark of carcinogenesis -> Mutation of tumor suppressor genes can contribute to carcinogenesis. -> 95%

CHAIN: Oncogenes behave dominantly by promoting cell proliferation and inhibiting cell death -> Overactivation of oncogenes can lead to uncontrolled cell growth -> Uncontrolled cell growth is a characteristic of cancer -> Oncogenes play a role in carcinogenesis -> 90%

CHAIN: The RB gene is a tumor suppressor gene that regulates the cell cycle -> Loss of function mutations in the RB gene can lead to uncontrolled cell division -> Uncontrolled cell division is a hallmark of cancer -> Mutation in the RB gene can contribute to carcinogenesis -> 90%

CHAIN: The RAS gene is an oncogene that promotes cell proliferation -> Mutations in the RAS gene can lead to uncontrolled cell growth -> Uncontrolled cell growth is a hallmark of cancer -> Mutation in the RAS gene can contribute to carcinogenesis -> 90%
